# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.1.1

- Logo: replaced with the official Google Sheets product icon (Google productlogos `sheets_2020q4`) on a white rounded tile with transparent corners, so clients show it as a whole mark instead of a cropped page.

## 1.1.0

- Refreshed the `google-sheets` skill for the latest tool surface.

## 1.0.0 - initial release

- Logo: official Google Sheets product icon on a padded white tile.
- Added the `google-sheets` MCP server pointing at `https://api.cursor.com/rest-mcp/google-sheets/mcp`.
- Bundled the `google-sheets` skill covering A1 and grid coordinates, formatting, charts, and validation.
